treaty_name: Convention between the Grand Duchy of Luxembourg and the Republic of Kosovo for the elimination of double taxation with respect to taxes on income and on capital and the prevention of tax evasion and avoidance, with Protocol (2017)
eif_quote: La convention entre le Grand-Duché de Luxembourg et la République du Kosovo ... faite à Luxembourg, le 8 décembre 2017 est entrée en vigueur le 23 juillet 2019 et est applicable à partir du 1er janvier 2020 (Mémorial A – N° 522 du 30 juillet 2019).
source_title: Chambre des Députés, dossier parlementaire 7390 (consolidated PDF): English text of the Luxembourg-Kosovo Convention and Protocol (signed 8 Dec 2017) as approved; published in Mémorial A 2019 n° 495 (legilux viewer requires JavaScript)

rates.quote: a) 0 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company (other than a partnership) which holds directly at least 10 per cent of the capital of the company paying the dividends;
b) 10 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

2. However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.
1. Royalties arising in a Contracting State and beneficially owned by a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State.

ppt.basis: treaty art. 27(1) (Entitlement to benefits - principal purpose test)
ppt.quote: 1. Notwithstanding the other provisions of this Convention, a benefit under this Convention shall not be granted in respect of an item of income or capital if it is reasonable to conclude, having regard to all relevant facts and circumstances, that obtaining that benefit was one of the principal purposes of any arrangement or transaction that resulted directly or indirectly in that benefit, unless it is established that granting that benefit in these circumstances would be in accordance with the object and purpose of the relevant provisions of this Convention.

notes: Interest taxable only in residence State (Art. 11(3)) when paid on credit sales of equipment/merchandise/services, on any bank loan, to a collective investment vehicle, to the other State/central bank/local authority, or "on intercompany loans" - conditions on loan type/recipient, not modelled as plain tiers. Protocol 1: collective investment vehicles treated as residents and beneficial owners. Convention done in English only.
